note: Authoritative sources from which each Capability-4 external-decoder contract is derived. Each excerpt is sliced VERBATIM from the named upstream header at the pinned tag; excerpt_sha256 hashes the archived excerpt file, full_file_sha256 records the complete upstream header so the excerpt can be re-verified by re-downloading that exact tag. Contracts are tied to a specific library + version-range + exact signature, NOT to a bare function name.

excerpts.prototype: int LZ4_decompress_safe(const char* src, char* dst, int compressedSize, int dstCapacity)
int LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int targetOutputSize, int dstCapacity)
int LZ4_decompress_fast(const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize)
excerpts.extent_semantics: originalSize is the EXACT number of bytes written into dst (a lower/exact bound), not an upper bound

authorities.upstream_url: SYNTHETIC (test-only; not a real library, never linked in a real build)
authorities.note: This authority is the archived synthetic spec itself; full_file_sha256 == the spec's sha256. It exists only to exercise unconditional exact/lower-bound routing.

excerpts.prototype: void synth_fill_exact(char* dst, int n)  [writes EXACTLY n bytes, unconditional]
void synth_fill_atleast(char* dst, int n)  [writes AT LEAST n bytes, unconditional]
